integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames the cavernous interior of a burning steel factory: sagging catwalks glow under orange flames, sparks cascade from ruptured pipes, and black smoke rolls beneath the corrugated ceiling. On the left, a knight in a weathered brown robe ignites a blue lightsaber with a sharp hiss; on the right, a red Sith in crimson-and-black armor raises an already-humming red lightsaber. The camera tracks the two duelists at fast speed as they sprint across the debris-strewn floor and their blades collide in a burst of white sparks. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a medium shot of the locked blades; the camera arcs around the crossed lightsabers with large amplitude while the knight twists his wrists and drives the Sith back one step, then two, sparks raining onto the smoldering grating. A steel beam groans and collapses off-screen, hurling a wall of embers across the frame. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a low-angle close-up where blue and red light trembles across both strained faces, then pulls out with large amplitude at fast speed as the knight sweeps his blade upward in a bright arc, the Sith staggers toward the wall of fire, and the two silhouettes hold their stance amid swirling smoke until the shot ends.

overall_soundscape: The burning factory roars with crackling flames and the metallic groan of overheated steel, punctuated by debris clattering across distant catwalks. The lightsabers hum and sizzle through the air, each blade impact lands with a sharp electric crack, and heavy boots grind across the metal floor as the duelists breathe hard.

non_diegetic_music: Pounding percussion at a fast tempo drives sustained low brass, while sharp string stabs accent every blade clash; the full orchestra swells through the final exchange and holds one resonant chord before cutting to silence.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic sci-fi blockbuster grade, high contrast teal and fiery orange palette, a low-angle wide shot on a 24mm lens frames the hooded knight in a brown robe (a 35-year-old man with a weathered face, short beard, wearing a heavy dark brown hooded cloak over a beige tunic, holding a glowing blue plasma-blade sword) and the masked warrior in black armor (a tall menacing figure in matte black armored plates and a dark metallic visor mask with red-tinted lenses, holding a glowing crimson plasma-blade sword) charging at each other across a narrow iron catwalk inside a burning industrial factory, massive flames roaring below them. Their blue and crimson plasma-blade swords collide at the center of the frame, sending a violent shower of white-hot sparks cascading down into the smoky abyss. The camera trucks right at slow speed while shaking slightly on the impact, as flickering orange firelight and electric neon glows carve sharp silhouettes through rising black smoke and drifting embers, accompanied by the deep electric hum of the blades and a sharp crackling clash. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a tight medium shot on a 50mm lens capturing the hooded knight in a brown robe and the masked warrior in black armor locked in a fierce cross-guard struggle, their glowing energy blades vibrating inches from their faces. The masked warrior in black armor presses downward with brute force while the hooded knight in a brown robe grits his teeth, sweat glistening on his brow as a background pipe bursts in a plume of fiery sparks. The camera arcs around them with small amplitude, harsh crimson and cyan plasma light dancing across matte black armor and rough brown wool fabric, synced with the straining sizzle of locked energy and a metallic groan from the catwalk. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a dynamic low-angle medium shot on a 35mm lens following the hooded knight in a brown robe as he spins away to break the lock and swings a wide horizontal slash that the masked warrior in black armor barely parries, the force knocking the masked warrior in black armor back a step against a flaming steel girder. A wave of glowing embers erupts upward around them as both warriors drop into tense combat stances, blades humming brightly. The camera pushes in at fast speed and shakes slightly as the girder impacts, intense orange backlights and vivid plasma reflections cutting through thick heat haze with a resonant whoosh and a heavy clang of steel.

overall_soundscape: Roaring industrial fires, the deep rhythmic hum and sharp electric crackle of colliding plasma blades, hissing steam, and the metallic clanking of boots on an iron catwalk.

non_diegetic_music: An intense orchestral score with driving brass, heavy taiko percussion, and fast string ostinatos building tension toward a dramatic crescendo.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a static wide shot frames an abandoned brick factory under a flat gray sky, its tall windows shattered and rusted steel beams and collapsed pipework littering the cracked concrete yard. A faint orange glow flickers deep inside the window openings, then the building erupts in slow motion: a fireball swells outward through the windows and doorways, its incandescent core tearing into white-hot tongues as the brick walls bow and split. The camera shakes strongly as the deep detonation boom stretches into a long, low rumble, and a shockwave rolls a visible ring of dust and grit across the ground while the roofline lifts in a spray of splintered planks. [Shot 2] At 00:02.400, the camera cuts to a medium slow-motion shot near the factory corner, where the fireball keeps churning and expanding, black smoke curling around its glowing rim. Bricks, glass shards, and a spinning sheet of corrugated metal tumble past the lens in slow motion, clattering against the concrete, while the shockwave sweeps across the yard as a low dust wall that flattens the dry weeds. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed as glowing debris arcs down and thick smoke gradually swallows the frame.

overall_soundscape: A low wind brushes the empty lot before a deep detonation boom stretches into a long, rolling rumble. Bricks, metal, and glass patter and clatter onto the cracked concrete, steel beams groan under the collapsing roof, and fine dust hisses as the shockwave sweeps past.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, high-contrast blockbuster color grade with teal shadows and glowing orange highlights, high-speed slow-motion photography, a low-angle wide shot on a 24mm lens frames a massive abandoned red-brick factory with tall smokestacks against a dusky steel-blue sky. Suddenly, the central structure erupts in ultra-slow motion; a blinding orange fireball expands outward and rolls into thick black smoke, while a visible shockwave ring of grey dust races across the cracked asphalt ground toward the lens. Heavy masonry debris and shattered glass shards arc through the air as the camera shakes strongly on impact then slowly pulls out at small amplitude. Intense fiery light illuminates the surrounding ruins and floating embers, synced to a deep sub-bass detonation boom, a sharp shockwave crack, and the low rumble of falling concrete.

overall_soundscape: A deep, chest-rattling sub-bass explosion boom in slow motion, followed by the sharp crack of a supersonic shockwave, the low roar of a rising fireball, and the heavy rumble of falling brick and shattering glass.

non_diegetic_music: A single, massive orchestral brass and sub-bass impact hit that swells into a tense, sustained low drone.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, epic fantasy scale, a sweeping establishing shot frames a medieval castle of grey granite walls and square towers at dusk, its wooden gates barred and torn banners snapping in the wind. A colossal black dragon with obsidian scales and ember-lit eyes dives out of the low storm clouds, its wingspan stretching across the entire fortress. The camera tracks the dragon with large amplitude at fast speed as it sweeps over the outer wall, opens its jaws, and pours a torrent of fire across the battlements; flames wrap around a tower, stone cracks and splits, glowing embers rain down, and tiny figures of soldiers scatter along the ramparts. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a low-angle tracking shot racing through the courtyard beside armored soldiers running over wet cobblestones, shields raised against the falling embers; one soldier stumbles under the weight of his shield and a comrade hauls him up by the arm, firelight flickering across their steel plates, while a stable door bursts open and panicked horses bolt past them. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a wide shot as the black dragon lands on the roof of the great hall, slate tiles sliding and shattering beneath its claws; it rears its head and breathes a second river of flame along the outer wall, and the gatehouse arch collapses in a rolling cloud of dust while soldiers leap from the ramparts into the moat below. The camera tilts up with large amplitude at slow speed as the dragon beats its wings, lifts off, and climbs into the smoke-blackened sky, the burning castle glowing beneath it.

overall_soundscape: A deep bellowing dragon roar mixes with the continuous roar of flames and the crackle of burning timber. Armored footsteps pound across wet cobblestones, steel plates clank, soldiers shout wordlessly, and heavy wing beats whoosh overhead as stones grind and crash in the collapsing gatehouse.

non_diegetic_music: Pounding war drums at a fast tempo drive layered brass fanfares while a low choir sustains a rising note; the percussion doubles in intensity as the dragon takes flight, and a single swelling brass chord holds until the end.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, dark fantasy blockbuster grade with high-contrast orange firelight against cold slate-blue shadows, a low-angle wide shot on a 24mm lens frames a colossal black dragon with jagged obsidian scales and leathery wings descending through dark storm clouds toward the stone towers of a medieval castle, tiny crows scattering for scale as its chest glows bright orange from within. The camera tilts up at slow speed as the creature opens its jaws and unleashes a massive jet of roaring fire downward. Heavy wingbeats thud through the air, followed by a deep guttural roar and the ignition whoosh of flames. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a wide tracking shot on a 35mm lens across the stone courtyard as the torrent of liquid fire strikes the battlements above, exploding into a rolling fireball and black smoke while showering the ground with burning stone debris and glowing embers. Distant soldiers in steel armor sprint away from the blast wave as a dust ring expands across the cobblestones. The camera trucks backward at fast speed and shakes strongly on impact, bathed in intense flickering orange firelight and heat haze. Stone shatters loudly over crackling flames. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up on a 50mm lens of the medieval soldier in steel plate armor (thirty-year-old man, soot-stained face, wide eyes, dull steel helmet and chainmail under a torn dark grey tabard) sprinting toward the lens in terror as the giant black winged silhouette of the dragon sweeps across the burning sky behind him, unleashing a second wave of fire along the castle wall. The camera tracks backward with the medieval soldier in steel plate armor, shaking slightly as bright orange rim light flashes across his soot-covered face and steel helmet while ash and glowing sparks swirl around him. Heavy metallic footsteps clank rapidly amidst the deafening roar of fire and Distant shouts.

overall_soundscape: Heavy leathery wingbeats and a deep monster roar give way to the deafening whoosh of roaring flames, shattering stone battlements, and the rapid clanking of steel armor as soldiers flee.

non_diegetic_music: Epic orchestral score with thunderous war drums, low brass blasts, and frantic string ostinatos building to a dramatic climax.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, photorealistic sci-fi, an extreme wide shot frames a vast space battle above the glowing blue curve of a planet: hundreds of spaceships — darting single-seat fighters, angular grey frigates and long gunships — swarm across the darkness in layered squadrons, their engine nozzles burning white-blue, while red and green laser bolts streak through the void in crisscrossing lines. The camera trucks right with large amplitude at fast speed through the outer edge of the swarm as nearby fighters flash past, laser bolts snap by, and two small ships burst into brief orange sparks. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a medium-wide shot of the battle line, where a tight formation of fighters banks and rolls while firing rapid laser pulses toward an enemy formation; the camera holds a tracking shot on the lead fighter as its tracer bolts hammer the flickering shield of a grey frigate until the shield collapses and the hull plating glows orange. [Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a low-angle wide shot of a massive armored cruiser hanging above the planet's bright limb, its dark hull plating and lit windows stretching across the frame; converging laser beams from dozens of enemy ships rake its flank, and secondary explosions bloom one by one along its engine section. The camera shakes strongly as the cruiser's reactor ignites — a blinding white fireball tears the ship apart from the inside, a ring of burning debris spins outward, and the shockwave ripples through the surrounding dust while smaller ships scatter. [Shot 4] At 00:08.800, the camera cuts to a wide shot and pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed, revealing the drifting debris field of the destroyed cruiser glowing with embers above the planet, while hundreds of spaceships continue dueling in the background, their laser bolts still crossing the darkness.

overall_soundscape: A deep layered engine rumble and thruster hiss run under the whole battle, punctuated by rapid high-pitched laser zaps, sharp metallic impacts on shields, and brief crackling bursts as small ships explode. The cruiser detonates with a massive rumbling boom followed by rolling secondary explosions, and the video ends with drifting debris clatter and distant cannon fire.

non_diegetic_music: A driving orchestral brass ostinato at a fast tempo over pounding percussion, swelling to a thunderous full-orchestra hit at the cruiser's explosion, then thinning to a low sustained drone as the debris drifts.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic sci-fi blockbuster VFX, high-contrast orbital lighting, crisp deep-space grade, a wide establishing shot on a 24mm lens frames a colossal space battle in high orbit above the glowing blue curve of a clouded planet, as hundreds of sleek fighter silhouettes swarm around a massive angular grey battlecruiser while volleys of red and cyan laser bolts streak across the void, the camera trucking right at slow speed, harsh white sunlight raking across metallic hull plates and casting deep shadows, tiny thruster plumes and glowing plasma sparks drifting through space, accompanied by a deep orbital sub-bass rumble and rapid laser fire. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a medium tracking shot on a 35mm lens following the armored midsection of the giant battlecruiser as heavy cyan laser beams slam into its hull, ripping open dark steel plates and igniting pockets of venting atmosphere before a blinding orange fissure cracks along the main reactor spine, the camera pushing in with small amplitude, flickering red and orange plasma light reflecting off scarred metal and floating hull fragments, glowing embers and spinning debris peeling away into the vacuum, synced to the sharp crackle of energy impacts and groaning metal. [Shot 3] At 00:06.800, the camera cuts to a wide low-angle shot on a 28mm lens capturing the doomed battlecruiser silhouetted against the bright planetary horizon as its core detonates in a massive expanding fireball that rolls into dark smoke and plasma, snapping the warship in two and hurling a bright shockwave ring of dust and glowing shrapnel outward, the camera shaking strongly on impact before drifting back, intense orange blast light illuminating passing fighter hulls, molten debris arcing across the frame, matched with a thunderous muffled detonation and fading metallic resonance.

overall_soundscape: A deep cosmic sub-bass rumble underpins the relentless rapid-fire zaps of heavy laser cannons and the sharp sizzle of energy impacts on metal hulls. The climax erupts with a massive, resonant explosion followed by the low groaning of tearing steel and scattering debris.

non_diegetic_music: Epic orchestral sci-fi score with urgent brass swells, driving taiko percussion, and a dramatic, booming crescendo as the cruiser explodes.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic food-commercial style, warm golden light fills a busy neighborhood canteen in Lévis, Québec, with a worn wooden counter and a glowing kitchen pass in the background. A medium close shot frames a cook's hands shaking a fryer basket as a cascade of golden, crispy fries tumbles into a paper serving boat, steam curling upward through the light. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the steaming fries as droplets of oil glisten on their surfaces. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to an overhead close-up as the cook's fingers sprinkle a generous handful of fresh white cheese curds over the fries; the plump curds bounce, nestle between the fries, and squeak faintly against each other. The camera arcs with small amplitude around the bowl while the rising steam softens the edges of the curds. [Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up as a ladle pours thick, glossy brown gravy in a slow ribbon over the curds, which visibly melt and begin to stretch. A fork sinks into the poutine and lifts a bite, pulling long molten cheese strands that flow downward through the warm light, and the camera tracks the falling strands with small amplitude before settling on the complete, steaming poutine resting on the counter as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: A fryer sizzles steadily beneath low canteen chatter and clinking cutlery. The fries crackle as they land in the paper boat, cheese curds patter softly onto the pile, and the gravy pours with a thick, slow liquid sound, followed by a gentle fork scrape against the boat.

non_diegetic_music: Upbeat acoustic guitar with light hand-percussion at a moderate tempo, building slightly as the gravy pours and ending on a warm, sustained chord.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic food commercial, warm golden-hour color grade, shallow depth of field, high contrast, a tight close-up on an 85mm lens frames a classic red-and-white checkered snack-bar tray holding a mountain of golden crispy fries topped with fresh white squeaky cheese curds. Thick, glossy hot brown gravy pours in slow motion from a metal ladle, cascading over the curds and sending up wisps of white steam. The camera pushes in at slow speed with small amplitude, catching warm tungsten key light and crisp specular highlights on the rich gravy and melting curds, accompanied by the rich sizzle of hot fries and the thick pour of gravy. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up on a 90mm lens of a silver fork lifting agenerous bite of hot fries and gravy-coated cheese curds straight up from the tray. Long, gooey strands of melted white cheese stretch taut and glisten as the fork rises in slow motion through rising steam. The camera tilts up at slow speed to follow the stretching cheese, backlit by warm golden rim light from the snack-bar window that makes the gravy and melted curds glow, with the soft, wet stretch of warm cheese and gentle background kitchen sizzle. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up on a 50mm lens showing the smiling young man in a denim jacket (a 28-year-old man with short brown hair, light stubble, warm brown eyes, wearing a classic blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt) seated at a wooden picnic table outside the Lévis snack bar, taking a steaming bite from his fork while the full tray of glistening poutine rests centered in the foreground. He closes his eyes with a genuine, satisfied smile and nods appreciatively as warm sunset light rims his hair and highlights the glossy gravy on the hero dish. The camera holds in a static shot, accompanied by the crisp crunch of a golden fry and a contented sigh.

overall_soundscape: Hot frying oil sizzling softly in the background, thick gravy pouring over crispy fries, the soft stretch of melted cheese, and a crisp, satisfying bite.

non_diegetic_music: Upbeat, warm acoustic guitar and punchy handclaps with a feel-good folk-pop groove that builds to a bright, appetizing finish.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a high-end commercial look, a medium close shot frames a faceted crystal perfume bottle filled with blush-pink liquid, its polished rose-gold cap gleaming under soft directional studio light, hanging above a mirror-still pool of clear water set into a white marble surface, with a few pale-pink rose petals resting near the edges and crisp rim highlights tracing the glass edges. The bottle drops and pierces the surface; a crown-shaped splash erupts in slow motion, crystal-clear droplets fanning outward and catching the light while the first pink tendrils bloom through the water. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the sinking bottle. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to an underwater macro view: the bottle drifts weightlessly, wreathed in silky rose-pink plumes that unfurl in slow motion, fine bubbles streaming upward past the glass facets as a single rose petal sinks slowly through the hazy background. The camera arcs with small amplitude at slow speed around the bottle, rim light tracing its silhouette through the pink haze. [Shot 3] At 00:03.600, the shot cuts to a low-angle close shot at water level inside the shallow marble basin: the perfume bottle stands upright in a few centimeters of clear water, glossy droplets sliding down the facets and faint pink pigment still curling around its base, concentric ripples calming ring by ring. The camera holds a static shot as one last soft ripple expands around the bottle and the marble reflections settle into stillness.

overall_soundscape: A deep, resonant splash bursts as the bottle breaks the surface, followed by surging underwater currents and a fine stream of rising bubbles. Droplets patter back onto the water while the expanding ripples gradually fade to near silence.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano notes at a slow tempo over a sustained low string drone, swelling gently in volume as the splash lands, then thinning to a single held note that fades out with the final frame.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, high-end luxury commercial photography, crisp studio grade with rich rose and gold tones, phantom high-speed slow-motion look, a centered vertical close-up on an 85mm lens frames a heavy faceted crystal perfume bottle with a brushed gold cap and pale pink liquid inside, resting on a glossy black water surface against a deep burgundy studio gradient. In extreme slow motion, a crown of crystal-clear water and velvety pink rose petals erupts upward around the base, arcing gracefully in mid-air before settling into gentle concentric ripples that leave the bottle pristine and centered. The camera executes a push in of small amplitude at slow speed. Crisp studio rim lights and a soft overhead key light create brilliant specular highlights across the wet glass, gold metal, and translucent water droplets, accompanied by a resonant, deep water splash and the delicate, crystalline chimes of falling droplets.

overall_soundscape: A deep, resonant slow-motion water splash followed by the delicate, crystalline trickling of droplets hitting a calm surface.

non_diegetic_music: A lush, atmospheric luxury score featuring a single warm cello note, ethereal harp arpeggios, and a soft, shimmering synth pad at a slow tempo.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, a luxury gold wristwatch with a polished gold case, a champagne dial marked with slim gold indices and fine gold hands, and a brushed gold link bracelet stands upright at the center of the frame against a pure black background, lit by soft directional studio light from the upper left. The watch begins rotating on itself at a steady, slow pace, like on an invisible turntable, while the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the dial. As the case turns, hard golden reflections sweep across the sapphire crystal and the mirror-polished case flank, and bright highlights travel link by link along the bracelet. On the glossy black surface below, a faint inverted reflection of the watch shimmers and slides with the rotation. By the final moment the watch has rotated into a three-quarter profile view, the light grazing the bezel in a thin golden line as the shot ends.

overall_soundscape: A soft, precise mechanical ticking from the watch movement underlies a low, quiet studio ambience. A faint whisper of polished metal accompanies the slow rotation, while the black studio space stays almost silent around it.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse, resonant piano notes at a very slow tempo over a low sustained string pad, thinning to a single held tone in the final second.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, commercial macro photography, high-contrast luxury studio grade, 65mm spherical lens, razor-sharp focus and deep blacks, a centered macro medium close-up on a 65mm lens frames a luxury 18-karat gold mechanical wristwatch suspended against a pitch-black studio void. The timepiece rotates smoothly on its vertical axis, starting in three-quarter profile, catching a bright specular sweep across its sapphire crystal and fluted bezel at the peak of the turn, and settling into a clean front-facing hero angle as golden gears tick steadily inside the black skeleton dial. The camera pushes in at slow speed with small amplitude, while a soft overhead key light and a moving warm rim light glide across the brushed gold links and polished edges, accompanied by the crisp, rhythmic metallic ticking of the escapement.

overall_soundscape: Crisp, rhythmic mechanical ticking of a precision watch movement in a quiet studio space, with a subtle warm resonant hum as light sweeps across the metal.

non_diegetic_music: Minimalist luxury score featuring a slow, resonant felt-piano melody over a warm, sustained cello bass note.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a train-station platform bathed in warm late-afternoon light slanting through a glass-and-steel canopy, with a stopped passenger train resting along the platform and a few travelers drifting across the background. A silver-haired man in his late fifties wearing a beige corduroy jacket waits beside a wooden bench, his gaze sweeping over the alighting passengers. A gray-bearded man in a navy wool coat steps down from the carriage holding a battered brown leather suitcase, and both men freeze mid-step as they recognize each other. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed as they stride toward one another, the bearded man letting the suitcase drop beside his shoes.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up as the two men collide into a tight embrace, arms wrapping fully around each other, the corduroy jacket bunching under the bearded man's gripping hands. The silver-haired man with a warm, slightly hoarse voice (S1) says into his friend's shoulder: <d>[French] T’as pas changé, mon vieux.</d> The bearded man's back shakes with a silent laugh while he pats his friend's shoulder blade.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the camera cuts to an intimate close-up over the bearded man's shoulder: two weathered faces pressed cheek to cheek, eyes glistening, mouths trembling into smiles as a quiet laugh breaks through a sniff. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as the men loosen the hug but keep their hands clasped on each other's shoulders, the idle train and warm platform light filling the background.

overall_soundscape: A low station hum carries under a muffled platform announcement while the idling train exhales air. Quick footsteps build on the pavement, followed by the dull thud of the dropped suitcase and the firm double thump of the embrace. Soft back pats land on wool, mixed with breathless laughter and a wet sniffle.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse piano notes at a slow tempo, joined by warm sustained strings that swell gradually through the embrace and soften as the two men step back.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm 35mm film look with soft golden hour light and shallow depth of field, a medium wide shot on a 35mm lens frames a misty historic train station platform under a high glass roof as steam drifts from a stopped dark green train carriage. The white-haired man in a beige wool coat (a 65-year-old man with short white hair, a trimmed white beard, warm wrinkled eyes, wearing a beige wool overcoat and a dark grey scarf, carrying a worn brown leather travel bag) stands by the carriage door, drops his brown leather bag onto the stone platform, and freezes with wide, glistening eyes as the balding man in a navy tweed jacket (a 65-year-old man with balding grey hair, round tortoise-shell glasses, a kind weathered face, wearing a navy blue tweed jacket over a cream cable-knit sweater) steps forward from the opposite side with his hands raised in disbelief. The camera pushes in at slow speed with small amplitude, while golden late-afternoon sunlight cuts through the rising steam and distant station rumble echoes softly. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a medium two-shot on a 50mm lens as the white-haired man in a beige wool coat and the balding man in a navy tweed jacket close the last steps between them and pull each other into a tight, long embrace, the hand of the balding man in a navy tweed jacket patting the back of the beige wool coat of the white-haired man in a beige wool coat while both men close their eyes. The camera arcs slowly around them with small amplitude, catching warmamber rim light from the tall station windows on their grey hair and wool fabrics, accompanied by the rustle of heavy coats and a shaky, relieved exhale. [Shot 3] At 00:06.800, the camera cuts to an over-the-shoulder close-up on an 85mm lens favoring the face of the white-haired man in a beige wool coat as the two men pull back slightly, the hands of the balding man in a navy tweed jacket still resting on the shoulders of the white-haired man in a beige wool coat. The white-haired man in a beige wool coat looks at his friend through watery eyes, smiles warmly with a trembling chin, and speaks softly. The white-haired man in a beige wool coat (S1) says in a warm, slightly raspy older male voice, tender and moved: <d>[French] T’as pas changé, mon vieux.</d> The camera holds in a static shot with a shallow bokeh of golden light and drifting steam behind them, as a quiet breath and the distant hiss of the train fade out.

overall_soundscape: Distant low rumble of an idling train and soft hiss of steam under a high glass hall, followed by heavy footsteps, the rustle of wool coats during the embrace, and a quiet emotional sigh.

non_diegetic_music: Solo melancholic piano joined by warm, gentle cello notes at a slow tempo, swelling softly during the embrace and dropping low under the spoken line.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, bright and playful vertical smartphone-clip style, a low-angle shot frames a fluffy orange-and-white tabby cat balancing on a scratched blue skateboard at the top of a sunlit concrete driveway, a tiny red helmet buckled under its chin. The camera tracks the cat as it kicks the ground twice with a hind paw and rolls downhill, tail stretched out for balance and ears flattened by the rushing air, letting out a short, determined squeaky meow. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a ground-level close-up of the white wheels rattling over a wide sidewalk crack; the camera shakes slightly with the vibration as the board wobbles, the cat crouches low with its fur rippling, then leaps off toward screen-left, lands softly on all four paws, and the empty skateboard tips over behind it with a hollow clatter.

overall_soundscape: Skateboard wheels rumble and rattle steadily over sunlit concrete, layered with the soft taps of a hind paw kicking the ground and the faint jingle of the helmet strap. A light breeze rushes past, ending with the thump of paws landing on pavement and the clatter of the empty board falling over.

non_diegetic_music: A fast-tempo ukulele strum with snapping fingers and a bouncy kazoo melody, the rhythm halting abruptly on a single plucked string note as the skateboard tips over.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, bright vertical social-media comedy, crisp smartphone video look with warm sunny colors and high contrast, a low-angle medium shot on a 28mm lens frames the chubby ginger tabby cat in tiny black sunglasses (a plump orange and white striped tabby cat with fluffy cheeks, wearing tiny black plastic sunglasses tilted slightly on its nose, green eyes peeking over the rims) standing on a wooden skateboard with neon green wheels on a sunny suburban sidewalk, front paws gripping the nose as he pushes off with one back paw and glides forward with a serious, confident expression. The handheld camera tracks backward ahead of him at fast speed with small amplitude, keeping his determined face centered in the vertical frame. Bright afternoon sunlight casts a crisp shadow on the concrete and glints off the black sunglasses, while urethane wheels rattle loudly over pavement cracks. integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG, bright storybook educational style made for children, a wide establishing shot frames a sleeping volcano on a small green island: a smooth gray-brown cone with mossy green lower slopes and a rounded crater, set against a clear blue sky with puffy white clouds. The camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed toward the volcano's flank, and the outer rock turns semi-transparent like frosted glass to reveal a clean cutaway cross-section: beneath layered bands of dark rock, a bulbous magma chamber glows deep orange, its thick molten rock churning slowly while small gas bubbles rise and shimmer yellow. A low, steady rumble rolls under the scene.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a close view inside the cutaway, where a narrow rocky conduit connects the glowing magma chamber to the crater far above. The camera tracks upward at slow speed, following the magma as pressure squeezes the thick orange melt up through the pipe; gas bubbles swell, wobble and pop against the rock walls, the molten rock brightens from deep orange to hot yellow, and thin veins of melt branch into the surrounding stone. Thick glugging and gurgling sounds accompany the climb, with faint creaks from the straining rock.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a low-angle wide shot at the crater rim as the volcano erupts: a fountain of bright lava bursts from the vent, glowing blobs arc over the rim against the blue sky, and a soft gray ash plume drifts upward. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed, revealing slow rivers of glowing lava trickling down the cone's flanks while small cooled fragments patter onto the slopes, the cross-section still faintly visible showing the emptied conduit below.

overall_soundscape: A low underground rumble runs beneath gentle island wind and sparse birdsong. Thick magma glugs and gurgles as it climbs the conduit, followed by a deep eruption boom, hissing spray, and the soft pattering of cooled rock fragments landing on the slopes.

non_diegetic_music: Playful marimba notes and plucked strings at a moderate tempo, joined by light hand percussion that quickens as the magma rises, resolving into a bright, bouncy flourish after the eruption.
